R1.change: Replace hook-completion-only publication observation with bounded observation of the actual committed database while the direct-parent hook is running. Store.ObserveCursorRotation performs a single context-bound snapshot checking complete runtime/connection/process/pipe/fd identity, exact examined launch/server/socket/pane, fresh row/session/path and required outgoing current-life archive. Atomic observation reaches the controller independently of the hook returning. Consumed intentional exit cancels the report hook; a final snapshot follows confirmed hook exit. Controller joining and observation use only the original first-control deadline. The observed committed binding is carried into transcript/report/shutdown even if reporting later fails. Intentional exit continues to actual owned-runtime termination and protected SessionEnd only after final reconciliation; blocked/failed persistence still cannot produce ended.
R1.evidence: Existing publication-before/after, report-error-after-commit, owned death, exit/pause/interrupt and real direct-parent pane success tests pass. Exact stalled-after-COMMIT/unreleased-helper cases are not yet separately authored; see next Test Writer instructions. No inference of commit from payload, screen, hook stdout or exit status.

R2.change: Capture epoch, provisional state and admitted session under the same mailbox mutex at actual admission. Carry the provisional bit through emit/insertion rather than recomputing it from later rotating state. Publication cannot transform parked provisional input into ordinary old-session admission. Existing CheckCursorPrompt and epoch-owned promotion remain the only fresh-admission path. Submit also refuses a mismatched admitted conversation before runtime/report/model activity.
R2.evidence: Existing delayed ordinary admission, Task1 admission-before-insertion, aliases, capacity/holds/FIFO tests pass. Exact during-rotation-admission -> publication -> insertion causal test is still unauthored and is not claimed proven.

S1.change: After successful rotation_confirmed synchronization, a consumed intentional exit continues to intentional finalization instead of returning confirmation-retired. No uncommitted fresh identity is installed. Other retired authority still fails closed.
S1.limit: Retained pre-repair red receipt is from the initial Test Writer; this pass did not rerun pre-edit source.

S2.change: Keep queue ownership of promoted unstarted submissions and visibly cancel every queued ID during cleanup before the persistenceFailed early return. Visibility does not depend on the broken recorder. Durable final cancellation remains conditional on recorder health and remaining original budget; published identity/archive are never rolled back or replayed.

S3.change: Retired authorization classification returns its known originating session from the existing request-ID/tool ownership. Retired event and authorization records reuse submission_session_id attribution already supported by the protected recorder. Retired numeric RPC response attribution uses monotonically ordered per-session request boundaries, bounded by the existing 4096 confirmed-conversation cap; initialize/unknown origin remains empty. It never invents main/child origin or grants current authority.
S3.remaining_coverage: New explicit top-level attribution assertions for retired numeric responses and unknown initialize response should be added by the Test Writer; current retained S3 assertions pin events and permission/plan callbacks.

technical_decisions_for_root_srd: Supersede the original Task2 claim that a one-shot buffered hook completion is sufficient publication observation. Observe actual atomic runtime/row/required-history snapshots while the hook is alive; observing commit and completing the hook/report are distinct.

Cancel the hook on consumed intentional exit; reconcile after confirmed hook exit and carry actual observed committed identity into owned-runtime finalization. All observation/join/store acquisition remains bounded by the original first-control deadline; exhaustion remains uncertainty/failure rather than rollback or successful ended.

Treat provisional status as part of the consumption-time admission snapshot, alongside epoch and session, and preserve it through insertion. Promotion alone transfers to admitted fresh-session queue ownership after existing durable guards.
Every known unstarted queue owner gets a visible per-ID cancellation even when protected persistence has already failed. No successful protected disposition or terminal state is fabricated.
Known-retired protected records retain their actual known conversation; retired-response origin is bounded by per-conversation numeric request boundaries. Unknown origin stays unknown.
recovery_wording: Cursor rotation requested; new input is held until publication
Cursor rotation already pending; repeated control ignored
Cursor rotation failed or stopped; held input refused to both conversations; no automatic replay
Cursor held submission <id> refused; nothing sent to either conversation
Cursor submission <id> cancelled before dispatch: gateway stopped
Cursor rotation report failed; publication may already be committed; held input refused
No restore/load/resume/replay procedure is introduced. Failure or exhausted protected persistence never promises saved history, rolled-back publication or ended success.
